categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" announcements under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land title registration, cadastral maps, land ownership claims, and land parcel determinations in various villages within the Polonnaruwa District. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, ownership claims, and title settlement matters.
